name: popsicle
headline: Prismeto: Content Distribution for Developers
short_description: Prismeto helps engineers distribute technical blog posts across multiple platforms (LinkedIn, Twitter, email newsletters) by automatically adapting content to each channel's format requirements.
author: AaronSausage

sections.overview:
Prismeto is a content distribution tool designed for engineers and technical writers who want to amplify their blog posts without spending time on repetitive marketing tasks. It simplifies the workflow by taking markdown blog files and preparing optimized versions for different social platforms and email newsletters, each adapted to that channel's specific requirements. Rather than manually logging into LinkedIn, Twitter, email platforms, and other channels to reformat content, developers can use Prismeto to streamline the entire distribution process. The tool solves the common problem where engineers create valuable technical content but lack time or motivation to properly promote it across multiple channels.
Distribute a technical blog post to LinkedIn, Twitter, and email newsletter in one workflow
Adapt blog content to platform-specific character limits and formatting requirements
Eliminate repetitive copy-pasting and reformatting across social media platforms
Increase visibility of technical content without manual cross-posting effort
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/AaronSausage/prismeto`
sections.usage:
```
Convert this technical blog post about [TOPIC] into a content distribution plan for [COMPANY]. Include a 30-day distribution schedule, target platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter, Dev.to), and engagement strategies for each. Focus on [INDUSTRY] professionals.
```
Copy

```
# Content Distribution Plan for [COMPANY]
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
